$comment: TS-017 D1 — the register of every runtime dependency, one line of reason each. An entry in package.json dependencies that is absent here fails scripts/check-stack.ts (TS-017-A1); an entry here that is not a dependency fails too. The deny-set is changed by a decision, not by a commit.

next.reason: The one rendering and routing framework: Next.js App Router, server-first, on Vercel.

react.reason: The rendering runtime Next.js is built on; not a second framework, a peer of the first.

react-dom.reason: The DOM renderer half of React, required by Next.js.

@schafe-vorm-fenster/brand-design.reason: The binding design system: colour and type tokens, logos, font packages. Consumed, never copied; pinned exact so a brand change arrives as a reviewable version bump.

@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible-next.reason: Self-hosted woff2 faces of the brand typeface; a direct dependency because pnpm does not hoist the brand package's own dependencies to our import paths.

@fontsource/atkinson-hyperlegible-mono.reason: Self-hosted woff2 faces of the brand mono typeface, used for labels, dates and numbers.

lucide-react.reason: The one icon set (24px grid, 2px stroke). Exactly one icon dependency is allowed; no glyph is drawn by hand.

zod.reason: Schema validation for content frontmatter and, from M3, for every external payload crossing the BFF boundary.

denySet.$comment: TS-017 D1 [PROPOSED]: no source enumerates forbidden frameworks. These are the alternatives a second framework would arrive as.
